summary: A file-based API client for one developer, with a small local web UI: requests as YAML in git, secrets only from the shell, assertions and chaining, history with diffs, and an importer for Insomnia's v4 export. Bruno is the free open-source answer; this is the version you can read in an afternoon.

stack.choice: Node 22, a CLI plus a localhost page

prerequisites.name: Node.js 22 or newer
prerequisites.why: Everything in this build runs on it: the server, the scripts, the tests.
prerequisites.get: Download the LTS installer from nodejs.org, or install with your package manager (brew install node, or nvm install 22). Restart the terminal afterwards.

prerequisites.name: A terminal and a code editor
prerequisites.why: Every step below is a command you type or a file you edit.
prerequisites.get: VS Code (code.visualstudio.com), Cursor or Zed. Open a folder for the project and use the editor's built-in terminal.
prerequisites.verify: You can open a folder and run a command in its terminal

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.why: History for your code, and the way most hosts deploy.
prerequisites.get: Install from git-scm.com or with your package manager, then run git init in the project folder once it exists.

prerequisites.name: Try Bruno first
prerequisites.why: The fork that stayed file-based and offline. Use it unless you want your own.

prerequisites.name: Your Insomnia export (v4 JSON)
prerequisites.get: Insomnia > Preferences > Data > Export Data > Insomnia v4 JSON.

env.name: API_UI_PORT
env.where: Localhost port for the small UI.

phases.title: Runner
phases.goal: One request from YAML with substitution; secrets from the shell only.

steps.do: Create the CLI and define requests/*.yaml and environments/*.yaml
commands: mkdir api-cli && cd api-cli && git init && npm init -y && npm pkg set type=module && npm install yaml@2

steps.do: Implement api run <file> --env <name> with {{var}} and {{env.NAME}} substitution and pretty output

check: A missing variable fails naming itself

phases.title: Assertions and chaining
phases.goal: Non-zero exit on failure; a token captured into the next call.

steps.do: Status and JSON-path asserts, exit 1 with a diff
capture into variables for later requests in a folder run

check: A login feeds a token to the next call

phases.title: History
phases.goal: Every run to SQLite; list and diff.

steps.do: Record runs with status, latency, size and body hash
api history and api diff commands

check: Diff shows a changed field between the last two runs

phases.title: Local UI
phases.goal: A localhost page listing requests, running one, showing the response.

steps.do: Serve a server-rendered page on API_UI_PORT listing requests
Run from a button and show the highlighted response

check: A request edited in the file appears on reload and runs from a button

phases.title: Import

steps.do: Parse the v4 export into requests and environments

check: An exported workspace runs after import

phases.title: Share with a team
phases.goal: Publish the CLI and run the collection in CI.

steps.do: Publish privately or as a git dependency
Run in CI with secrets from the CI store

check: CI fails on a failed assertion

product.outcome: API tests in the repo, run in CI, with no synced workspace to leak a secret.

operations.incident: Rotate a leaked secret at its source.

releaseGate: CI passes on a real collection

notIncluded: Cloud sync, RBAC, mocks, gRPC: the seat price.
